name: Red Bull Ring
scope: Elevated Spielberg circuit, pit lane, low kerbs, edge lines, gravel and runoff; scenery excluded; broad model-derived grass slopes and foundation
limitations: Road pieces are fitted rectangular blocks with small essential overlaps at bends.
The source pit route is smoothed and its connection is adapted to the widened racing road.
Kerbs and runoff use model material/colour cross-sections, with tiny texture fragments merged.
Stored byte/object limits cannot be inferred from the client export.
Roadside grass uses narrow fitted slope strips; open areas use broad planar patches and foundation tiles. Outer terraces and rectangular borders remain.

worldGradientSmoothing.method: Smooth world gradients; shared planar gradients through tight corners; close the elevation profile through the intervening sections
